assertions.assertion: The CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) is being appealed.
The service in question is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring).
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42).
The patient presents with an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73).
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes.
